DDA.TamerWizard.Guide.Welcome: A Tamer is not just a sheet. This creation is using the {level} Campaign Level. Let's build everything in small steps.

DDA.TamerWizard.Guide.Torments: Torments are fears, pains, or doubts the character must face. Distribute exactly {boxes} marked boxes among up to two Torments.
